updateLog.en:
What's new in this version:
- Optimized word-by-word lyrics search: multi-keyword strategy, higher hit rate for original lyrics
- Fixed issue where some songs couldn't fetch word-by-word lyrics
- Fixed matching failure for duet songs caused by different artist separators
- Fixed Live-version lyrics being wrongly selected
- Fixed known bugs and improved stability

Main features:
- Word-by-word lyrics synthesizer (FLAC/MP3, multi-threaded)
- In-app update checker with download progress
- Play alongside other apps toggle
- Blur transition for full-screen player (Android 12+)
